topics.title: Solids, Liquids and Gases
topics.notes:
## States of Matter

### Particle Model
All matter is made of particles.

| Property | Solid | Liquid | Gas |
|----------|-------|--------|-----|
| Arrangement | Regular | Random | Random |
| Movement | Vibrate | Move around each other | Rapid random motion |
| Forces | Strong | Moderate | Weak |
| Distance | Very close | Close | Far apart |

### Energy
- Solid → lowest energy
- Liquid → medium energy
- Gas → highest energy
topics.examTips: Always link answers to particle arrangement, movement, and energy.

topics.title: Changes of State
topics.notes:
## Changes of State

- Melting (solid → liquid)
- Boiling (liquid → gas)
- Freezing (liquid → solid)
- Condensation (gas → liquid)

### Key Idea
Temperature remains constant during change of state because energy is used to overcome forces.
topics.examTips: Mention energy used to overcome forces for full marks.

topics.title: Diffusion
topics.notes:
## Diffusion

Movement of particles from high → low concentration.

### Key Points
- No external energy needed
- Faster in gases

### Factors Affecting Diffusion
- Temperature ↑ → faster
- Mr ↑ → slower
- Distance ↑ → slower

topics.title: Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
topics.notes:
## Definitions

- Element: One type of atom
- Compound: Chemically combined elements
- Mixture: Physically combined substances

### Key Differences
- Compounds → fixed ratio
- Mixtures → variable ratio

topics.title: Atomic Structure
topics.notes:
## Atomic Structure

| Particle | Charge | Mass |
|----------|--------|------|
| Proton | +1 | 1 |
| Neutron | 0 | 1 |
| Electron | -1 | ~0 |

### Key Definitions
- Atomic number = protons
- Mass number = protons + neutrons

### Electron Configuration
Example: Na = 2,8,1

topics.title: Isotopes
topics.notes:
## Isotopes

Same number of protons, different neutrons.

### Key Idea
- Same chemical properties
- Different physical properties
topics.examTips: Always mention SAME electrons → SAME chemical properties.

topics.title: Ionic Bonding
topics.notes:
## Ionic Bonding

Transfer of electrons.

### Properties
- High melting point
- Conduct when molten or aqueous
- Giant lattice structure
topics.examTips: Say 'electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions'.

topics.title: Covalent Bonding
topics.notes:
## Covalent Bonding

Sharing of electrons.

### Properties
- Low melting point
- Do not conduct electricity
- Weak intermolecular forces
topics.examTips: Do NOT confuse intermolecular vs covalent bonds.

topics.title: Formulae
topics.notes:
## Chemical Formulae

- Empirical formula: simplest ratio
- Molecular formula: actual number of atoms

topics.title: Equations
topics.notes:
## Balancing Equations

Atoms must be equal on both sides.

Example:
CaCl2 + 2KI → 2KCl + CaI2

topics.title: Electrolysis
topics.notes:
## Electrolysis

Decomposition using electricity.

### Key Rules
- Cathode: reduction
- Anode: oxidation

topics.title: Exothermic and Endothermic
topics.notes:
## Energetics

- Exothermic: releases heat
- Endothermic: absorbs heat

topics.title: Rates of Reaction
topics.notes:
## Rate of Reaction

Factors:
- Temperature
- Concentration
- Surface area
- Catalyst

topics.title: Acids and Bases

0–14
